scripts.compile: tsdown && cp ./dist/index.mjs /tmp && pnpm compile:linux-arm64 && pnpm compile:linux-x64 && pnpm compile:mac-arm64 && pnpm compile:mac-x64 && pnpm compile:win-x64
scripts.compile:linux-arm64: cd /tmp && deno compile -A --no-check --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --output tunnel-0k-linux-arm64 index.mjs
scripts.compile:linux-x64: cd /tmp && deno compile -A --no-check --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --output tunnel-0k-linux-x64 index.mjs
scripts.compile:mac-arm64: cd /tmp && deno compile -A --no-check --target aarch64-apple-darwin --output tunnel-0k-mac-arm64 index.mjs
scripts.compile:mac-x64: cd /tmp && deno compile -A --no-check --target x86_64-apple-darwin --output tunnel-0k-mac-x64 index.mjs
scripts.compile:win-x64: cd /tmp && deno compile -A --no-check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --output tunnel-0k-win-x64.exe index.mjs
